notes: expected_delta.json is captured from the pristine app (never hand-written). Table list starts from the vote-flow sibling minus the vote tables (no votes are cast in this flow); Question_Interactions is kept because the post-submit redirect lands on showQuestion, which pings the view counter. Join tables use tags_id/watchers_id, not Tag_id/Watcher_id. UserSession is deliberately excluded: auth plumbing, volatile by nature. ignore_columns are stripped from inserted/deleted rows and update comparisons by the capture tooling.
